name: mascot
title: Mascot
description: Stubby, the pencil stub who does the drawing. He waves in welcomes, thinks in empty search results, sleeps when nothing is happening. An original character drawn as a die-cut sticker: a chubby pencil stub with a face and nothing else (no arms, no legs, no clothes). His mood is his face, a small lean of the body and one doodle floating beside him.

a11y: Decorative by default; the surrounding text ("Nothing here yet") is what carries meaning.
